title: handle-none-step-duration-in-monitor
request: AgentLogger crashes when a step has no duration; can you make the monitor show 'N/A' instead of formatting None?

+import pytest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from rich.console import Console
+
+from smolagents.monitoring import Monitor, AgentLogger, LogLevel
+
+def test_monitor_update_metrics_handles_none_duration():
+    console = Console(record=True)
+    logger = AgentLogger(level=LogLevel.INFO, console=console)
+    monitor = Monitor(tracked_model=None, logger=logger)
+
+    # Create a dummy step log with no duration and no token usage
+    step = SimpleNamespace(timing=SimpleNamespace(duration=None), token_usage=None)
+
+    # Should not raise an exception
+    monitor.update_metrics(step)
+
+    output = console.export_text()
+    assert "Duration N/A" in output
